result.fundName: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund - Regular Plan - Growth

insights: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund - Regular Plan - Growth decisively outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 3.48% (18.31% vs 14.83%).
Beat the benchmark in 87.0% of rolling windows — strong consistency for a Equity: Flexi Cap.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 1.28 vs benchmark 0.76, Sortino 1.68.
Defensive profile: beta 0.63 with 23% lower volatility than the benchmark.
Positive alpha of 10.35% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.41).
Higher drawdown risk: fund max drawdown -31.26% vs benchmark -38.11%.
Rolling return range spans 0.07% to 36.29% (36.22 pp spread) — consistency score 92.
This fund satisfies all three Golden Triangle conditions.
